app.title: Galactic Soup
app.tagline: A single-player space trading, exploration and combat game.
shell.status.label: Engine status
campaign.startReplaces: Starting a new campaign replaces the saved one.
campaign.contentChanged: That campaign was saved against different game content. Anything it refers to that still exists is kept, and the installed values apply from now on.
campaign.resetDetail: Resetting deletes this campaign and every save of it. This cannot be undone.
campaign.save.label: Campaign save status
campaign.save.failed: The last save did not complete. Your previous save is untouched.
campaign.storage.lowSpace: Local storage is nearly full. Free some space so the campaign can keep saving.
campaign.storage.notPersistent: This browser has not promised to keep the campaign. It may be cleared if space runs low.
shell.note.noCampaign: No gameplay systems are installed yet. This build verifies the application shell, the engine worker, the protocol gateway and the campaign save cycle.
compatibility.heading: Galactic Soup cannot start
compatibility.detail: The game runs its engine in a dedicated browser worker. Without one it cannot keep your campaign correct, so it will not continue.
compatibility.advice: Use a current desktop version of a Chromium-based browser or Firefox, and allow the page to run scripts and workers.
error.compatibility.workerUnsupported: This browser does not provide the dedicated worker the engine needs.
error.compatibility.workerFailed: The engine worker could not be started.
